errors.name: Radius
errors.message: It is a FLOAT variable in the file, and a variable's type cannot change: give the new one another name.

errors.name: Twice
errors.message: token --twice-a and codeSyntax.WEB "--twice-b" (--twice-b) name two CSS properties: give one of them.

errors.name: Odd
errors.message: 12em is not a colour, a length, a number, a quoted string, true/false or var(--token).

errors.name: Ease/In
errors.message: EASING variables cannot be written yet: COLOR, FLOAT, STRING and BOOLEAN can.

errors.name: Bad/Scope
errors.message: A COLOR variable cannot take GAP: its scopes are ALL_SCOPES, ALL_FILLS, FRAME_FILL, SHAPE_FILL, TEXT_FILL, STROKE_COLOR, EFFECT_COLOR.

errors.name: Fills
errors.message: ALL_FILLS already covers FRAME_FILL, SHAPE_FILL and TEXT_FILL: give it or them.

errors.name: Shade
errors.message: Library Colors comes from a library: change it there.

errors.name: Kit Colors
errors.message: Kit Colors comes from a library: change it there.

errors.name: Pointer
errors.message: --Nowhere names no variable in this file or in this call.

errors.name: Pointer/Chain
errors.message: --Pointer names no variable in this file or in this call.

errors.name: Mixed
errors.message: font: 400 16px 'Inter' is not part of a paint style: it takes only its background.

errors.name: Library Blue
errors.message: Library Blue comes from a library: change it there.

notes: --Primary is a variable of an enabled library that the file does not use yet: the write imports it into the file.
